lede: The web ran quiet and local today, with just one story crossing feeds: ComfyUI surfaced on both GitHub trending and Hugging Face, the lone thread tying two sources together. The biggest single number came from Hugging Face, where Black Forest Labs' flux-3-image-klein-comfy pulled 439,528 downloads, far ahead of the next model. On Wikipedia, Kim Jong Un led the day at 321,739 views, narrowly ahead of Jailer 2 at 303,129.

throughlines.gist: The open-source image-generation toolkit was the only topic to land on two feeds at once, trending on GitHub and Hugging Face together.
